title: Settlement Single-Record Accountability | BackOfficeFleet
html:
Settlement proof

Connect delivery, proof, adjustment, owner, and next action.

BOF gives each settlement one accountable record for the delivered work, supporting proof, rate or pay inputs, adjustments, questions, decisions, responsible owners, and downstream action.

Take the Assessment →

Source record

Load or work record, delivery proof, rate or pay basis supplied by the fleet, receipts, deductions, advances, adjustments, and questions.

Review path

The record is reviewed for source match, supporting evidence, exception state, owner, approved disposition supplied by the fleet, and clearance condition.

Decision-ready output

A ready, watch, or hold settlement record with evidence, chronology, decision, owner, and next move.

How the work moves

The record keeps the exception, owner, and consequence visible.

The settlement does not lose its operating context as it moves between delivery, billing, payroll, finance, and driver follow-up.

  1. 01

    Open the source record

    Load or work record, delivery proof, rate or pay basis supplied by the fleet, receipts, deductions, advances, adjustments, and questions.

  2. 02

    Review the operating question

    The record is reviewed for source match, supporting evidence, exception state, owner, approved disposition supplied by the fleet, and clearance condition.

  3. 03

    Name the exception and owner

    Unresolved evidence is assigned to a responsible person with a clear request, review state, and condition that must be satisfied before the record moves.

  4. 04

    Carry the outcome forward

    A ready, watch, or hold settlement record with evidence, chronology, decision, owner, and next move. The settlement does not lose its operating context as it moves between delivery, billing, payroll, finance, and driver follow-up.

Qualification

Administrative support stays inside a defined boundary.

BOF organizes administrative records and does not act as employer, payroll provider, bank, factor, accountant, tax adviser, or payment processor.

  • Public screens, records, statuses, and integration examples are static or synthetic unless a page explicitly states an authorized live capability.
  • The fleet, carrier, employer, agency, customer, and qualified professionals retain their operating, legal, safety, regulatory, and financial authority.
  • BOF does not guarantee release, acceptance, compliance, payment, collection, savings, audit, safety, or financial outcomes.
  • The BOF assessment qualifies the record set, responsible owner, service boundary, intended output, and appropriate next action.
